seo.title: HUD — Kickback
seo.description: HUD puts live leaderboards and team stats on the office TVs — real numbers from the same platform data Costing and Follow-Up run on. Coming soon.
seo.ogDescription: Your whole office, heads up. Live leaderboards and team stats from real platform data. Coming soon.

hero.lede: HUD puts live leaderboards and team stats on the office TVs — jobs closed, estimates out, win rates, revenue. Real numbers from the same platform data Costing and Follow-Up already run on, not another spreadsheet someone has to update.
hero.metaHtml: Coming soon · Built on the Kickback platform · Zero data entry

sections.title: Numbers everyone sees. Numbers everyone trusts.

items.title: Leaderboards that run themselves.
items.body: Nobody updates a whiteboard. Jobs, estimates, and wins flow in from the platform as they happen, and the board keeps score in real time.

items.title: One set of numbers.
items.body: HUD reads the same jobs, estimates, and costing data as every other Kickback app. When the TV says 23 jobs closed, your reports say it too.

items.title: On the TV in minutes.
items.body: If your CRM is connected to the platform, HUD has everything it needs. Point a browser at the board, fullscreen it, done.

suite.body: Leaderboards and live team stats on the office TVs. Everyone sees the same numbers in real time, pulled from the same platform data.
